episodes.title: Testimony 1 - Spiral Tuna : The Cult of Gigi Young #gigiyoung
episodes.description:
Testimony 1 - Spiral Tuna

Attention, Former Members and Followers of Gigi Young!

We created this YouTube channel where former members and followers of Gigi Young can anonymously share their personal experiences, opinions, and testimonies. Our purpose is not to harass, defame, or spread misinformation, but to provide a platform for personal stories.

If you would like to share your experience, email us using a pseudonym and an email address that does not reveal your identity.

With your explicit permission, we will adapt your testimony into a narrated video, preserving your experiences and opinions without revealing your identity or publishing your original messages.

Important: Please explicitly authorize us to use, edit, narrate, and publish your testimony. Do not submit private information about others, private footage, or copyrighted material you lack permission to share. You may use AI to help write your testimony, provided it reflects your own experiences.

YouTube Channel:
https://youtube.com/@testimonies_and_stories

Email:
testimonies.from.former.members.and.former.followers@hotmail.com
